protocol.title: Development of Digital Microfluidic Heterogeneous Immunoassays
protocol.author: Alphonsus Hon-Chung Ng
protocol.institution: Institute of Biomaterials and Biomedical Engineering, University of Toronto
protocol.platform: Two-plate digital microfluidics (DMF), oil-free, air-surrounded droplets with Pluronic L64 additive

key_innovations: First particle-based DMF immunoassay without oil carrier fluid
First competitive immunoassay (E2) implemented by DMF
Novel supernatant separation washing method (>90% unbound reagent removal per step)
First DISC method for in-situ single-cell immunocytochemistry with <4 s temporal resolution

device.configuration: Two-plate EWOD: patterned bottom-plate + unpatterned ITO top-plate

bottom_plate.substrate: Chromium-coated glass (2 in x 3 in x 1.1 mm, Telic Co.)
bottom_plate.hydrophobic_coating: Teflon-AF, ~200 nm (spin-coating, 1% w/w in FC-40, 2000 rpm, 60 s)
bottom_plate.fabrication: Standard photolithography + CR-4 wet etching at ECTI/TNFC cleanroom, University of Toronto

top_plate.disc_chapter_5_modification: Hydrophilic lift-off spots (1.75 mm diameter, 4.4 mm pitch) by fluorocarbon lift-off of S1811 photoresist on ITO

device.spacer: Two pieces of Scotch double-sided tape (3M), total thickness 180 um

actuation.signal_source: Function generator (Agilent) + high-voltage amplifier (TREK) for Ch2; DropBot + Arduino HV switching for Ch3-5

magnet.chapter2: Manual magnet movement via stripwell microplate manifold and metal clip
magnet.chapter3_chapter4: Motorized magnetic lens; up to 8 simultaneous separations; >600 uN force; deactivated by positioning 3.8 cm below device

detection.chapter2: Commercial well-plate reader (PHERAstar, BMG Labtech); LUM module; focal height 8.6 mm; gain 3600; device taped to 96-well Stripwell plate
detection.chapter3_chapter4: Integrated motorized PMT; LOD 4.88 uU/mL HRP; CV 0.56-9.3%
detection.chapter5: Axon GenePix 4000B microarray scanner; 532 nm and 635 nm lasers; 5 um resolution; 0 um focus; PMT 500 V; CellProfiler image analysis

reagents.anti_fouling_additive: Pluronic L64 (BASF Corp.), 0.05% v/v in all on-chip reagents

chapter2_reagents.TSH_particles: Mouse monoclonal Anti-beta TSH coated paramagnetic particles (Abbott ARCHITECT kit 7K62), ~3.0e8 particles/mL in DMF-compatible particle diluent
chapter2_reagents.E2_particles: Rabbit monoclonal Anti-E2 coated paramagnetic particles (Abbott ARCHITECT kit 7K72), ~3.0e8 particles/mL
chapter2_reagents.TSH_conjugate: Anti-TSH-HRP (goat polyclonal, Fitzgerald Industries), 2 ug/mL in conjugate diluent
chapter2_reagents.E2_conjugate: E2-HRP conjugated via 6-CMO (BiosPacific), 1 ug/mL in conjugate diluent
chapter2_reagents.substrate: SuperSignal ELISA Femto (Thermo Fisher Scientific): H2O2 + luminol/enhancer
chapter2_reagents.wash_buffer_pH7_7: Tris-base 0.35 g/L, Tris-HCl 1.10 g/L, NaCl 8.367 g/L, L64 0.05% v/v
chapter2_reagents.particle_diluent_pH10: Tris-base 6.1 g/L, NaCl 5.8 g/L, Sucrose 136 g/L, BSA 1% w/v, Thimerosal 0.05% w/v, L64 0.05% v/v
chapter2_reagents.conjugate_diluent_pH7_4: Tris-Base 1.9 g/L, Tris-HCl 13.2 g/L, NaCl 17.5 g/L, BSA 1% w/v, cold fish gelatin 0.1% w/v, Thimerosal 0.05% w/v, L64 0.05% v/v
chapter2_reagents.TSH_blocking_buffer_pH7_8: Tris-base 0.30 g/L, Tris-HCl 1.2 g/L, NaCl 8.76 g/L, Tween-20 0.01% w/v, NFDM 3% w/v; 1 h block then 2x DI water wash

chapter4_reagents.RV_particles: Rubella virus-coated paramagnetic particles (Abbott ARCHITECT rubella kits); 1.5e8 particles/mL in Superblock Tris-buffered saline
chapter4_reagents.RV_IgG_conjugate: HRP-conjugated goat polyclonal anti-human IgG, 21 ng/mL in conjugate diluent
chapter4_reagents.RV_IgM_conjugate: HRP-conjugated goat anti-human IgM, 23 ng/mL in conjugate diluent
chapter4_reagents.pretreatment: Goat anti-human IgG (IgM pretreatment reagent, Abbott ARCHITECT), 3x dilution in conjugate diluent; 900 nL merged with 1.8 uL sample, mixed 7 min
chapter4_reagents.sample_diluent: DPBS containing 4% BSA; samples diluted 10x before assay
chapter4_reagents.panel: Anti-rubella mixed titer performance panel PTR201 (SeraCare Life Sciences); 25 plasma/serum samples

chapter5_reagents.culture_media: DMEM + 10% serum (CS for NIH 3T3, FBS for MCF-7/MDA-MB-231) + 100 U/mL penicillin G + 100 ug/mL streptomycin + 0.05% Pluronic F68
chapter5_reagents.ligand: PDGF-BB in serum-free DMEM; concentrations 0-200 ng/mL
chapter5_reagents.GAPDH: Rabbit pAb, 2 ug/mL (SCB); used for optimization/density experiments

protocol_1_magnetic_particle_immunoassay.title: DMF Magnetic Particle-Based Immunoassay (Supernatant Separation Method)

assay_modes.TSH_non_competitive: Sandwich: Anti-beta TSH particles + TSH analyte + Anti-TSH-HRP conjugate
assay_modes.E2_competitive: Competition: Anti-E2 particles + E2 analyte competes with E2-HRP conjugate; higher analyte = lower signal

particle_prep_off_chip: Immobilize ARCHITECT particles with neodymium magnet in Eppendorf tube; remove diluent
TSH only: suspend in blocking buffer pH 7.8 (NFDM 3%, Tween-20 0.01%), incubate 1 h, wash 2x DI water
Resuspend at ~3.0e8 particles/mL in DMF-compatible particle diluent (pH 10)

washing_method.name: Supernatant separation
washing_method.mechanism: Magnet pellets particles on device surface; supernatant droplet actuated to waste; magnet removed; fresh droplet passed over pellet and circularly mixed (4 electrodes) to resuspend
washing_method.efficiency: >98% unbound reagent removal by wash 2 (vs serial dilution requiring 6+ washes for same benchmark)
washing_method.residual_liquid_retained_pct: ~5% of origin droplet; particles resuspended immediately to prevent drying

steps.name: Particle dispense and separation from diluent
steps.notes: Magnet positioned beneath device; diluent actuated to waste leaving particle pellet

steps.name: Sample incubation
steps.notes: 3 unit droplets (800 nL x 3 = 2.4 uL); chosen for optimal signal without compromising droplet reliability; particles continuously mixed during incubation to minimize non-specific adsorption

steps.name: Wash x4 in wash buffer + wash x2 in H2O2
steps.notes: 2x H2O2 wash developed to replace off-chip premixing; prevents high inter-assay variability from pre-mixed substrate

steps.name: H2O2 incubation
steps.notes: Particles moved to detection region (96-well aligned area)

steps.name: Luminol/enhancer merge
steps.notes: On-chip mixing immediately before measurement; activates HRP-catalyzed chemiluminescence

steps.name: Chemiluminescence detection
steps.settings_ch2: LUM module; focal height 8.6 mm; gain 3600; device taped to 96-well Stripwell
steps.notes: Chemiluminescence saturates at 1 min; chosen as measurement endpoint

optimized_platform_ch3.improvements: 90 Pogo pin interface; integrated motorized PMT; magnetic lens (up to 8 simultaneous separations); DropBot automation
optimized_platform_ch3.DOE_optimization: 3-level full factorial; factors: analyte concentration, sample incubation time, sample volume; optimal: 5 droplets, 3 min incubation
optimized_platform_ch3.measurement_procedure: Wash buffer immediately removed after final wash; particles resuspended in luminol-H2O2; mixed 4 min until signal saturates; stable measurement window ~1 min

analytes: RV IgM (indirect ELISA with IgG blocking pretreatment)
rubella_assay_ch4.particles: Rubella virus-coated paramagnetic particles (Abbott ARCHITECT kits); 1.5e8 particles/mL in Superblock
rubella_assay_ch4.IgM_pretreatment: Sample 1.8 uL + pretreatment reagent 900 nL (goat anti-human IgG) mixed 7 min on-chip before ELISA
rubella_assay_ch4.on_chip_dilution: 4 iterations of merge-mix-split; generates 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x dilutions; compatible with whole blood samples (10% to 15% CV at high dilutions)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: particle dispense through sample incubation + wash

protocol_2_disc.title: DISC: Digital Microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single Cells
protocol_2_disc.full_name: DISC -- Digital Microfluidic Immunocytochemistry in Single-Cells
protocol_2_disc.objective: Automated on-chip cell seeding, starvation, PDGF-BB stimulation, fixation, permeabilization, blocking, and dual-antibody immunocytochemistry; single-cell quantitation of phospho-Akt and PDGFR phosphorylation by laser scanning cytometry

passive_dispensing.mechanism: Source droplet translated across vacant lift-off spot (hydrophilic ITO); sub-droplet captured by hydrophobic-hydrophilic contrast to form virtual microwell (~400 nL)
passive_dispensing.subsequent_dispenses: Each new droplet displaces contents of virtual microwell; successive exchanges achieve >99% removal after 2 exchanges

cell_lines.primary: NIH 3T3 (murine fibroblast): DMEM + 10% CS + pen/strep; seeded at 500,000 cells/mL; 150-300 cells/VM
cell_lines.cancer_line_1: MCF-7 (human breast cancer): DMEM + 10% FBS + pen/strep
cell_lines.cancer_line_2: MDA-MB-231 (human breast cancer): DMEM + 10% FBS + pen/strep

protocol_2_disc.pdgf_signaling_pathway: PDGF-BB -> PDGFR auto-phosphorylation (Y857, Y1021) -> PI3K -> PIP3 -> Akt recruitment -> p-Akt (S473) -> cell survival/proliferation/migration

steps.name: Cell seeding
steps.operation: passive dispense x3 per lift-off spot
steps.notes: Device inverted; humidified chamber; cells adhere to hydrophilic ITO lift-off spots

steps.name: Serum starvation
steps.reagent: Starving media (0.5% serum + 0.05% F68 in DMEM)
steps.notes: Synchronizes basal PDGFR/Akt signalling before stimulation

steps.name: PDGF-BB stimulation
steps.notes: ~4 s between stimulation and fixation enables sub-minute temporal resolution; 93% of prior solution removed per exchange

steps.name: Cell fixation
steps.reagent: Fixing solution (4% paraformaldehyde + 0.05% F68 in DPBS)

steps.name: Cell permeabilization
steps.notes: Enables intracellular antibody access to Akt and PDGFR

steps.name: Blocking
steps.reagent: Blocking solution (1% bovine NFDM + 0.05% Brij 35 in DPBS)

steps.name: Primary antibody staining
steps.reagent_Akt: Pan Akt Mouse mAb 1:50 + p-Akt S473 Rabbit mAb 1:200 in BS
steps.reagent_PDGFR: PDGFR-beta Mouse mAb 1:50 + p-PDGFR Y857/Y1021 Rabbit pAb 1:200 in BS

steps.name: Secondary antibody staining
steps.reagent: Anti-Mouse IgG AF647 Fab2 1:500 + Anti-Rabbit IgG AF555 Fab2 1:500 in BS

steps.name: Phosphoprotein detection (off-chip laser scanning cytometry)
post_processing: Scan: GenePix 4000B; 532 nm + 635 nm lasers; 5 um resolution; PMT 500 V
CellProfiler: Otsu Global thresholding; 15-100 um cells; p-protein / total protein ratio per cell
steps.normalization: Per-cell ratio of phosphorylated (Cy3/AF555) to total protein (Cy5/AF647); fold change relative to serum-free negative control on same device

key_results.Akt_amplification_note: Only 10% max receptor phosphorylation needed for 50% Akt activation
key_results.cancer_line_hyper_responders: MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 show dramatically different hyper-responder populations; may correlate with cancer cell phenotype
key_results.reagent_volume_vs_flow_cytometry: 400 nL per VM vs ~200 uL per well (500x reduction)

bioscript_compiler_notes.ascii_constraint: ANTLR4 FileStream defaults to ASCII encoding; all Unicode characters (em dashes, beta symbol) must be replaced with ASCII equivalents before compilation
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: BioScript supports s and m only; h token not supported
bioscript_compiler_notes.mix_abstraction_protocol1: mix abstracts the supernatant separation sequence: magnet on -> actuate supernatant -> magnet off -> fresh droplet -> circular shuttle to resuspend
bioscript_compiler_notes.mix_abstraction_protocol2: mix abstracts passive dispensing over hydrophilic lift-off spot; not electrode-driven DMF mixing
